sections.text: You're listening to the Skeptics' Guide to the Universe, your escape to reality.
sections.title: Introduction

sections.text: “Truth is sought for its own sake. And those who are engaged upon the quest for anything for its own sake are not interested in other things. Finding the truth is difficult, and the road to it is rough.” - Ibn al-Haytham,Critique of Ptolemy
sections.title: Skeptical Quote of the Week
